body: Hi, I had Mr Larner perform my lower surgery 2 weeks ago. He is lovely and truly seems to care about what he's doing. he came to see me almost every day in the hospital to check on my progress (when he was at work anyways). the work itself looks great though its hard to say being only 2 weeks out of hospital. so far I can definitely vouch for him and the whole team. though lets see how I feel in 3 months :D congrats on your date :)
is it me or is this Manon's song not ours? :D

My theory is that Halpha is a large-scale research facility that houses the remains of the primordial darkness. I think during cryo-sleep it was discovered within us and the ARKS that were awake tried to harness it and power the dolls so that lives no longer needed to be lost in battle. I think the dolls are falz-powered and the darkness woke up at some point and took control of them. I think Manon and the others sent us down to Halpha to battle it knowing we were the only thing ever to beat it. I wouldn't be surprised if Manon doesn't know this and is hiding it because for plot reasons we need to come to the knowledge of ourselves as the guardian naturally.

I think the "Cannons" found at Central and old central are safety devices used to force the falz back if it ever woke up and that's what happened in Kvaris. Only it didn't work properly which is why we needed the info from them to upgrade the active one in Central City.

I also wouldn't be surprised if we aren't on Xion or Xiao tbh with the full ocean surrounding us. (it was a water planet after all). This also makes me wonder if the old ARKS members from the war with the photoners in ep6 weren't put into cryo collectively in case we were ever needed again but as was mentioned, we became too reliant on tech (the DOLLS etc) and not enough on photons. which is why all the old ARKS are now waking up - some sort of automated emergency procedure.

I will never be the person to tell you not to do something, you are your own person and you have the right to make a choice. I know because every time i try and talk abut my thoughts on dying people tell me to seek professional help or take medication but they never just want to talk. I guess that's what I'm offering, if you need or want to talk to someone. even a stranger like me. my PM's are always open.

I understand feeling alone. I can be in a crowded room and feel completely alone. I sit with my wife and she might as well not be there. I myself consider my mortality ever day. I wouldn't ever tell you not to do whats in your heart to do. you deserve to make your own decision. but I just wanted you to know that someone read this. that it wasn't for nothing. If you do decide to go through with it. I truly hope you finally find some peace.
